cs.t: If you can get a decent display in your region (because they usually nickel and dime European users and do unfathomable part sourcing), Lenovo are usually a good choice. I am a Portuguese Mac user and we still don’t have an official Apple Store in my country (although there are a few third-party certified support centres) and have been using mostly Surface laptops at work, but with the Apple Silicon switch I bought a mid-range Lenovo Ryzen laptop solely for running and building x86 Linux packages, and I am pretty happy with it even though it is plasticky and hardly as polished. I suspect the high end ones might be suitable, although to be fair I had an X1 Carbon a few years back and loathed it - it was the reason I opted for Surface laptops to run Windows.
cs.th: Ask HN: Is there a developer laptop that does not suck and is not a Mac in 2022?
